## Accepted OOS dispositions

- **OOS_1**: parse-bootstrap-routing-envelope.sh `set -e` abort in canonical Step 0 fence — deduplicated against https://github.com/character-ai/larch/issues/3565 (WI1; fixed at repo HEAD by #3492 with explicit `return 0` tails + dedicated regression harness; defect persists only in plugin cache 47.0.70). No new issue filed.

## Rejected / Out-of-Scope Observations (not filed)

- **OOS_1**: deduplicated against #3565 (see accepted-disposition record); listed here for marker completeness.
- FINDING_14: test-step3-review-cap.sh legacy-status expectations — accepted in an early review round; verified already addressed on this branch (harness now normalizes removed `converged`/`cap-hit` to panel-failed). Not filed.
- FINDING_15: test-design-postplan-emit.sh drift regression coverage — verified already addressed on this branch (write-once/exit-14/FD3 cases present; `assert_rc "drift trigger rc" 14`). Not filed.
- FINDING_22: test-design-structure.sh rc=14 thin-fence pins — verified already addressed on this branch (arm lists `0 10 11 12 13 14 2 1` in both assert loops + negative fixture). Not filed.
- FINDING_28: "single-pass loop appears aligned" — voted rejected (0 YES / 3 NO); observational, no defect.
- FINDING_29: "drift guard core behavior appears implemented" — voted rejected (0 YES / 3 NO); observational, no defect.
- FINDING_4: duplicate HTML-comment footer in approval-gates.md — neutral tally (1Y/1N/1 judge-error); not accepted; prompt-noise nit.
- FINDING_5: stale failure message in test-design-pause-resume.sh — neutral tally (1Y/1N/1 judge-error); not accepted; diagnostics-wording nit.
